<reason>PRO won the financing clash by separating voluntary commitment from forced lock-in. CON argued cheap bundles need sticky off-month revenue, but conceded most would not churn, letting PRO show flexibility is optional insurance plus an explicit stay-put discount, and turn the transit-pass analogy: the annual pass is cheaper because the monthly exit exists. CON never restored why a maze is needed to fund shows.</reason>
<best_rebuttal>PRO's Rebuttal 2 A1/A2 plus closing turn on the transit pass: if pause is rare it cannot kill 3-year commissions, if universal the cheap sticker depended on idle seats, so lock-in is extraction not production constraint.</best_rebuttal>
